Interface ValueMatcher

All Known Implementing Classes:
ValueMatcher.AllOf, ValueMatcher.AnyOf, ValueMatcher.Contains, ValueMatcher.EndsWith, ValueMatcher.Equals, ValueMatcher.Not, ValueMatcher.OneOf, ValueMatcher.Present, ValueMatcher.Regex, ValueMatcher.StartsWith
public sealed interface ValueMatcher permits ValueMatcher.Equals, ValueMatcher.StartsWith, ValueMatcher.EndsWith, ValueMatcher.Contains, ValueMatcher.OneOf, ValueMatcher.Regex, ValueMatcher.Present, ValueMatcher.Not, ValueMatcher.AllOf, ValueMatcher.AnyOf
A declarative matcher of a value: of a header, a query parameter, a cookie or the host of a request, see RouteCondition, or of a path variable, see RouteSpec.constrain(String, ValueMatcher). A matcher is data: the router can read, combine, reorder and index it, which a lambda does not allow. 
import static io.micronaut.web.router.builder.ValueMatcher.*;

routes.GET("/search")
    .where(RouteCondition.header("X-Channel", oneOf("beta", "canary").ignoringCase()))
    .handle(betaHandler);
routes.GET("/files/{name}")
    .constrain("name", startsWith(".").negate())
    .handle(filesHandler);

A matcher is given the value as it is, not decoded nor trimmed any further than the source of the value does, and compares it without copying it. It is given null for a value that is absent: only present() negated, or a combination that accepts it, matches an absent value.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
